poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE GLITTERING CURTAIN OF A PERFORMANCE IS ALWAYS THIN
poetryFrame.rightVertical: DANCE ON THE EDGE BETWEEN LORE AND FACTUAL DECEPTION
poetryFrame.bottomLine: YOU CANNOT CLAIM WHAT WAS NEVER YOURS TO KEEP
sonnetLines: The spotlight cuts the velvet dark,
A practiced smile, a whispered mark.
They dance within the polished haze,
Oh, careful of the pretty art,
That steals the truth and breaks the heart.
The whispers spun from silver thread,
Are echoes where no life was bred.
Look closer at the mirrored pane,
To find the source of all your pain.
A claim built on a fragile lie,
